shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- src/main.tsx ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- src/App.tsx ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- index.html ---\\n' && cat index.html && printf '\\n--- vite.config.ts ---\\n' && cat vite.config.ts && printf '\\n--- tsconfig.json ---\\n' && cat tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -c "npm view @gravity-ui/navigation versions --json && printf '\\n--- peer deps for v7 ---\\n' && npm view @gravity-ui/navigation@7 peerDependencies --json"

/bin/bash -c "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -maxdepth 3 -type f \\( -name 'INDEX.md' -o -name 'README.md' \\) | sed -n '1,40p'; printf '\\n--- navigation? ---\\n'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null"
/bin/bash -c "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json | sed -n '1,120p'; printf '\\n--- navigation README head ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md"

/bin/bash -c "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/dist 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,30p'; printf '\\n--- icon index sample ---\\n'; rg -n \"Sun|Moon|DisplayPulse|House|Rocket|Layers|CircleQuestion|LayoutHeader|Chart\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/dist/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,80p'; printf '\\n--- icons package version ---\\n'; node -e \"console.log(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json').version)\""

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts; printf '\\n--- types ---\\n'; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts; printf '\\n--- useTheme ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts"

/bin/bash -c "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build -maxdepth 3 -type f | sed -n '1,80p'; printf '\\n--- docs index ---\\n'; rg -n -C 3 \"AsideHeader|menuItems|renderContent|logo|compact|onChangeCompact|header\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -c "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons -maxdepth 3 -type f | sed -n '1,80p'; printf '\\n--- package main/types ---\\n'; node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify({main:p.main,module:p.module,types:p.types},null,2))\""

/bin/bash -c "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons -maxdepth 2 -type f -name '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,40p'; printf '\\n--- esm index ---\\n'; sed -n '1,60p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/esm/index.js 2>/dev/null || true; printf '\\n--- root files ---\\n'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | sed -n '1,60p'"

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' Sun SunIcon Moon MoonIcon House Gear DisplayPulse Layers CircleQuestion Rocket ChartBars Person Cloud Curtains CircleCheck CircleCheckFill LogoYandex ArrowRightArrowLeft Palette Star CircleQuestionFill | while read n; do if [ -f \"node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/"'$n.d.ts" ]; then echo "OK $n"; else echo "-- $n"; fi; done'

/bin/bash -c "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.d.ts; printf '\\n--- components index ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/index.d.ts; printf '\\n--- components types head ---\\n'; sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -c "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation -maxdepth 3 -type f \\( -name '*.css' -o -name '*.scss' \\) | sed -n '1,80p'; printf '\\n--- package files ---\\n'; node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json'); console.log('main',p.main); console.log('module',p.module); console.log('sideEffects',JSON.stringify(p.sideEffects)); console.log('exports',JSON.stringify(p.exports))\""

/bin/bash -c "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components -maxdepth 2 -type d \\( -name 'Card' -o -name 'Switch' -o -name 'Icon' -o -name 'Text' -o -name 'Button' \\) -print; printf '\\n--- Card d.ts ---\\n'; sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts 2>/dev/null; printf '\\n--- Switch d.ts ---\\n'; sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts 2>/dev/null"

/bin/bash -c "rg -n -C 2 \"interface ControlProps|type ControlProps\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | sed -n '1,80p'; printf '\\n--- full context ---\\n'; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -c "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components -maxdepth 3 -type f -name '*.d.ts' | xargs rg -l \"RenderContentType\" | sed -n '1,20p'; printf '\\n--- Content types ---\\n'; sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/Content/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,200p'"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/spacing/spacing.d.ts; printf '\\n--- Flex d.ts ---\\n'; sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true; printf '\\n--- Text d.ts ---\\n'; sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts"

/bin/bash -c "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build -type f | rg '\\.(css|scss)"'$'"' | sed -n '1,80p'; printf '\\n--- esm index head ---\\n'; sed -n '1,60p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.js; printf '\\n--- AsideHeader impl head ---\\n'; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.js"

/bin/bash -c "rg -n \"export .*Card|export .*Switch|export .*ThemeProvider|export .*Icon|export .*Text|export .*Button|export .*Flex|export .*Box\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | sed -n '1,120p'; printf '\\n--- uikit index head ---\\n'; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' Layers DisplayPulse House Gear Sun Moon CircleCheck CircleQuestion Person Cloud Rocket Star GaugeChart | while read n; do if [ -f \"node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/"'$n.d.ts" ]; then echo "OK $n"; else echo "-- $n"; fi; done'
